# reevingSystemTangentTest.py

You can view and download this file on Github: [reevingSystemTangentTest.py](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/tree/master/python/TestModels/reevingSystemTangentTest.py)

```{code-block} python
:linenos:

#+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
# This is an EXUDYN example
#
# Details:  The common tangent of two sheaves with non-parallel axes in ObjectConnectorReevingSystemSprings:
#           a rope between two sheaves on the ground, the second axis tilted towards the first sheave; the length
#           of the rope, the output variable Distance, compared with the tangent computed here by an independent
#           parametrization of the two circles (#3412)
#
# Author:   Johannes Gerstmayr
# Date:     2026-11-11
#
# Copyright:This file is part of Exudyn. Exudyn is free software. You can redistribute it and/or modify it under the terms of the Exudyn license. See 'LICENSE.txt' for more details.
#
#+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

import exudyn as exu
from exudyn.utilities import * #includes itemInterface and rigidBodyUtilities
import exudyn.graphics as graphics
from exudyn import cMath #the math functions of the C++ code, the same bits on every platform

testIsActive = exu.sys.get('testIsActive', False)

import numpy as np

SC = exu.SystemContainer()
mbs = SC.AddSystem()

#two sheaves: center p, unit axis a, radius R; the axis of B is tilted towards A, so |a x c0| differs for A and B
pA = np.array([0., 0., 0.])
aA = np.array([0., 0., 1.])
RA = 0.5
pB = np.array([3., 0.4, 0.2])
aB = np.array([0.6, 0., 0.8])
RB = 0.3

gA = graphics.Cylinder(pAxis=pA-0.05*aA, vAxis=0.1*aA, radius=RA, color=graphics.color.dodgerblue, nTiles=32)
gB = graphics.Cylinder(pAxis=pB-0.05*aB, vAxis=0.1*aB, radius=RB, color=graphics.color.dodgerblue, nTiles=32)
oGround = mbs.AddObject(ObjectGround(visualization=VObjectGround(graphicsData=[gA, gB])))
mA = mbs.AddMarker(MarkerBodyRigid(bodyNumber=oGround, localPosition=pA))
mB = mbs.AddMarker(MarkerBodyRigid(bodyNumber=oGround, localPosition=pB))

oRS = mbs.AddObject(ReevingSystemSprings(markerNumbers=[mA, mB], hasCoordinateMarkers=False,
                                         stiffnessPerLength=1e5, dampingPerLength=0, referenceLength=3,
                                         sheavesAxes=exu.Vector3DList([list(aA), list(aB)]), sheavesRadii=[RA, RB],
                                         visualization=VReevingSystemSprings(ropeRadius=0.02, color=graphics.color.red)))
mbs.Assemble()
lengthCpp = mbs.GetObjectOutput(oRS, exu.OutputVariableType.Distance)

#independent construction: points a(phi) = pA + RA*(uA*cos(phi) + vA*sin(phi)), b(psi) likewise; the line a-b is
#tangent to both circles if it is normal to both radius vectors, (b-a).(a-pA) = 0 and (b-a).(b-pB) = 0; the start
#phi = psi = 0 at u = -n,
#n = a x c0 normalized, which is the start of the C++ Newton iteration (caseA = caseB = 1)
c0 = (pB-pA)/cMath.norm(pB-pA)
def Frame(a):
    n = np.cross(a, c0)
    u = -n/cMath.norm(n)
    return u, np.cross(a, u)
uA, vA = Frame(aA)
uB, vB = Frame(aB)

def Points(x):
    pa = pA + RA*(uA*cMath.cos(x[0]) + vA*cMath.sin(x[0]))
    pb = pB + RB*(uB*cMath.cos(x[1]) + vB*cMath.sin(x[1]))
    return pa, pb

def Residual(x):
    pa, pb = Points(x)
    return np.array([(pb-pa) @ (pa-pA), (pb-pa) @ (pb-pB)])

x = np.zeros(2)
h = 1e-7
for it in range(30): #Newton's method, Jacobian by central differences
    res = Residual(x)
    if cMath.norm(res) < 1e-14:
        break
    jac = np.zeros((2,2))
    for j in range(2):
        dx = np.zeros(2); dx[j] = h
        jac[:,j] = (Residual(x+dx)-Residual(x-dx))/(2*h)
    x -= np.linalg.solve(jac, res)

pa, pb = Points(x)
lengthPython = cMath.norm(pb-pa)
difference = abs(lengthCpp-lengthPython)
exu.Print('reeving system with non-parallel sheave axes: length C++ =', lengthCpp, ', independent =', lengthPython,
          ', difference =', difference)

if not testIsActive:
    SC.visualizationSettings.connectors.showNumbers = True
    SC.renderer.Start()
    SC.renderer.DoIdleTasks()
    SC.renderer.Stop()

#the length, and the difference to the independent construction, which is 1e-15 if the tangent is right
u = lengthCpp + difference
exu.Print('solution of reevingSystemTangentTest=', u)
exu.sys['testResult'] = u
```
